pages.text: The capital is the village you spawned in. It is deliberately the only shared spawn: new settlers arrive there, raids are drawn to it, and it is where the server's first station, dock and market will be.$(br2)It belongs to everyone. Build in it, but build with the town, not over it.

$(bold)What makes a town a town$() here: a bell, beds, and villagers who sleep in them. Several mods check for exactly that. Trading depots, bounty boards and caravan stops all want a real settlement around them.$(br2)A hole in the ground with one librarian is not a town, and the pack will tell you so.

$(bold)Growing it:$() more beds and workstations draw more villagers; Village Expansion lets a town build itself out; guards hold the wall; workers tend the fields.$(br2)Villagers have names (Villager Names). Learn them. The one who sells the thing you need will be gone if the raid gets through.
